artworks.title: J'ai vu un lièvre... il y a huit jours!
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures standing in a landscape. The scene features two individuals viewed from behind, one gesturing energetically and the other standing passively, both wearing period clothing that includes caps and vests. The landscape depicted has open fields stretching into the distance, with hints of a building and vegetation on the horizon. The drawing employs fine lines and shading to convey texture and form, contributing to a sense of depth in the composition.

artworks.title: Ah! il est frais... mais t'nez donc garçon...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a formal dining scene. The image depicts a group seated around a table outdoors, where a waiter or server is presenting a dish under a canopy of trees. The figures at the table appear to be engaging in conversation while the server is positioned in a manner suggesting they are serving the main course. The shading and lines give depth to the image, especially the foliage overhead and the detailed attire of the participants. This composition captures a moment of interaction and serves as a vignette of a dining experience.

artworks.title: Qu'il est gentil comme ça, Dodore...
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a room. One man is washing his hands at a wash basin, a woman is leaning with her head on her hand, and a child in a plaid dress and large hat is facing away from the viewer. An arched shadow and a framed artwork can be seen in the background, along with a small towel hanging from the wash stand.

artworks.title: Ah! vous êtes fort en vers latins, jeune homme...
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in full view: two men and one boy. The man on the left is slightly hunched forward, with his hands together, while the central man stands with one hand in his pocket and the other holding the boy's hand. The boy stands facing forward, holding a stack of books in his right hand. The man on the left has a prominent nose and chin, and he wears glasses and a tall black top hat. His hair is not visible under the hat. The central man has a large nose and a concerned expression, his hair is also covered by a tall black top hat. The boy has a mop of curly hair and facial features that suggest an expression of disapproval or discontent. All three are dressed in 19th-century clothing. The man on the left wears a long coat that reaches his knees, with pinstriped trousers and boots. The central man wears a dark jacket and trousers with a vest, and the boy wears a matching dark suit with a vest and bow tie. The background depicts an urban setting with suggestions of building facades sketched against the wall, and the ground is flat with slight shading suggesting shadows.

artworks.title: Papa contemplant l'image de son image
artworks.description: The image shows two people and a child. The man is holding a small framed portrait, seated with dark wavy hair and a faint smile. He wears a dark suit with a bow tie. Next to him, a standing woman holds a child. The woman wears a headscarf and a patterned long-sleeved dress. The child wears a simple gown. The background is dark and textured.

artworks.title: Je crois que j'ai entendu chanter un hibou...
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing close to a window, gently lifting a curtain while looking outside. The individual is wearing nightwear, including a cap, a long nightshirt, and bare legs and feet. The person's face appears focused. The room is dimly lit, with shadows highlighting the curtain and the person's attire. In the background, there is a bed with messy sheets. The image is signed in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Au novel an, visite... a la tante Rabourdin
artworks.description: The image features five figures positioned closely together in an interior setting. Three adults and two children are shown in the scene. On the left, a young boy stands looking up at the adults. A young girl stands next to him with her hands clasped together. The adults appear to be in conversation, with two women at the center holding hands, both wearing bonnets and long dresses with puffed sleeves. A man stands behind them, wearing spectacles, a coat, and a cravat. The background shows a sketched portrait hanging on the wall.

artworks.title: Bourgeois se fesant lire, après diner, quelques chapitres...
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, one seated and one standing. The seated person is facing to the right with their hands clasped in their lap, legs crossed. They have their eyes closed and curly hair, wearing a jacket over a shirt and pants, sitting on a wooden chair. The standing person faces the seated individual, reading from a book with long hair and a focused expression, dressed in a long dress with puffed sleeves. In the background, there is a door, a framed item on the wall, and furniture with a bowl or pot. The image is monochromatic with cross-hatching shading.

artworks.title: Le Jour ou il s'agit de faire une conquête
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring two figures looking at a reflective surface displaying a different figure. The scene shows two individuals engaged in an exchange. The drawing showcases fine details and expressive line work. The ambiance suggests sophistication, with the fashion and furnishings hinting at a particular era.

artworks.title: Doux loisir d'un quincailler retiré di commerce...
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals resting under a tree. The two figures are reclining on the ground next to the tree, which is detailed with intricate lines and shading. In the background, there are gentle rolling hills that add depth to the landscape. The drawing emphasizes relaxation and companionship in nature. The use of black and white gives a timeless quality to the artwork.

artworks.title: Est-il dieu permis... fendre du bois...
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing of a person chopping wood inside a room, while another person looks on from a doorway. The person with the axe is poised to strike a large log on the ground. The setting includes furniture, such as a chest of drawers, with a hat and a bottle placed on top. The observer in the doorway seems to show interest or concern. The artwork conveys movement and feelings through precise lines and shading.

artworks.title: Inconvénient de visiter sans précaution un entresol...
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals in a 19th-century setting. On the left, a figure wearing a long coat and a tall hat appears startled, with exaggerated gestures and a surprised expression. On the right, an older woman in traditional attire stands calmly with a steady gaze. The room has patterned wallpaper, and the sketch features strong lines and shading with contrast between light and shadow.

artworks.title: Brigand de propriétaire...
artworks.description: The image shows a man lying on a bed, with his entire body visible, mostly covered by a blanket. He is positioned leaning back against a pillow, holding an open umbrella above him. The man has a beard and is wearing a nightcap, with his eyes focused upward. His facial features appear relaxed as he reclines. He is dressed in nightclothes, including a long gown, and is tucked under a blanket. Beside the bed rests a chair draped with clothing, and on the floor lies a book or a piece of paper. The background features a darkened room with a large skylight or window above, through which rain seems to be falling.

artworks.title: Un Locataire qui a eu un oubli le 1er janvier
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals. A woman is sweeping with a broom, appearing stern with furrowed brows and distinct facial lines. She wears a long-sleeved dress, an apron, and something covering her hair. A man below her looks upward with his mouth open, wearing a top hat, bow tie, jacket, waistcoat, and prominent facial hair. The background features a wooden railing, cross-hatched walls, and falling dust or powder between the figures.

artworks.title: Guide, allons-nous-en... au nom du ciel...
artworks.description: The image shows two people in a rocky environment. Both figures are depicted in full, with their bodies positioned on a rugged rock formation. The person on the left is an older man wearing a hat with a long brim and facing slightly upwards. His facial features include a pronounced nose and chin, short hair, and he is wearing a long coat over striped pants, holding a staff with both hands as he leans back against the rock. Behind him, a younger, shorter person looks up towards the older man. This individual is also wearing a hat, and their facial features are less detailed. The background comprises softly shaded areas suggesting a sky and landscape with distant hills and a body of water. Indistinct structures and trees are visible on the horizon. No specific jewelry or other objects are evident in the image.

artworks.title: Attends... j'te vas en donner... du maitre d'école
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated man holding a whip, a surprised onlooker, and several other people watching. The man behind the desk is wearing a hat and spectacles. The onlookers have varying expressions. The setting is an interior with a desk and a textured wall in the background.

artworks.title: Mission pénible et délicate du professeur de dessin...
artworks.description: The image shows the upper bodies of three individuals in a room. One person is seated, holding a drawing pad, with a bald spot and hair remaining at the sides. The person behind them, standing, rests a hand on the chair's back. They wear a cap, goggles, and a dark coat, holding a plumb bob. A third person is seated to the left. The background includes a lined backdrop and a large drawing displayed on the wall.

artworks.title: Une Position difficile
artworks.description: The image shows three people. On the left, a person sits with their bare torso visible. In the center, another person, perhaps an artist, crouches with their face turned to the side, near an easel or canvas. On the right, a third person stands holding a hat. The background is shaded, with a framed picture on the wall.

artworks.title: Entrez donc, monsieur... ne vous gênez pas...
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing with a forward lean, in clothing consisting of a long dark coat and striped trousers. He holds two bottles, and his top hat is seen flying off his head. The man has a surprised expression, with wide eyes and a slightly open mouth. The background shows a row of buildings and other figures in the distance, with cobblestones on the ground.

artworks.title: Diable!... il parait que le rasoir n'est guère bon...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a barbershop scene. The image depicts an interior setting with one individual seated with a cape wrapped around them, and another individual shaving a customer. The background includes wooden paneling, hanging garments, and a hat on wall hooks. The monochromatic color scheme captures a moment of daily life with a touch of humor. This is in the style of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Équitation boutiquière
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two individuals horseback riding in a park. The scene shows two riders on horses wearing dark attire and hats. They ride on a path surrounded by leafless trees, with other people on horseback seen in the background. There is a signpost in the scene, and the style is similar to Honoré Daumier's illustrative works.

artworks.title: Et on appelle ça descendre le fleuve de la vie...
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals walking. The person on the right wears a high top hat, a coat with long tails, and tight-fitting trousers. The person has a pronounced nose, sideburns, and a mustache, with short, sleek hair visible under the hat. The person on the left holds a parasol above their head. They wear a bonnet, a long skirt with an overlay of fabric, and a fitted bodice. The background is a countryside setting with sketchy vegetation and a distant building. The sky is depicted with sweeping lines representing clouds.

artworks.title: Le Puits de Grenelle
artworks.description: The image shows three figures. On the right side, a man is in a bent-backward stance, holding a child at a distance from him. The man has an elongated face with furrowed brows, wearing a tall top hat, long dark coat, and dark trousers. The child has dark hair and is dressed in a simple one-piece outfit, appearing wet. On the left side, a woman stands slightly angled towards the man and child. She has wide eyes, curly hair partially covered by a bonnet, and is wearing a long flowing gown with a cape-like wrap, with her hands raised slightly towards the scene. The background is a blank expanse with minimal detail and faint lines suggesting distant structures or objects.

artworks.title: Les Badauds
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several individuals leaning over a railing, observing something in the water below. The scene depicts people wearing top hats standing on a cobblestone path by a river, looking at a figure floating down the river. In the background, an ornate bridge and buildings line the riverbank. The drawing includes intricate details with defined textures and shadows. Handwritten text is present in the artwork.
